title: Colorado Revised Statutes, Title 40, Article 3 - Regulation of Rates and Charges
verified_how: Expanded the official CRS Annotated table of contents: 'Title 40. Utilities (ss 40-1-101 - 40-43-104)' > 'Public Utilities (ss 40-1-101 - 40-17.5-105)' > 'General and Administrative (Arts. 1 - 9.8)', which lists live 'Article 3. Regulation of Rates and Charges (ss 40-3-101 - 40-3-121)', with neighbours 'Article 3.5. Regulation of Rates and Charges by Municipal Utilities (ss 40-3.5-100.3 - 40-3.5-107)', 'Article 4. Service and Equipment (ss 40-4-101 - 40-4-122)', 'Article 8. Unclaimed Funds for Overcharges (ss 40-8-101 - 40-8-105)', 'Article 8.5. Unclaimed Utility Deposits (ss 40-8.5-101 - 40-8.5-107)' and 'Article 8.7. Low-Income Energy Assistance (ss 40-8.7-101 - 40-8.7-112)'.
notes: Article 3 is the ratemaking core administered by the Public Utilities Commission; billing, deposits and disconnection rules sit in PUC rules (4 CCR 723). Municipal utilities are under Article 3.5, and the consumer advocate under Article 6.5.
